notFound: No public Hialeah lobbyist registry list: the City Clerk takes registrations through the Tyler EnerGov self-service portal (needs an account; not used), so no action has basis "registry". Links come from the minutes, which print "Registered Lobbyist:" and "on behalf of" lines under zoning items; the minutes do not name lobbyists for contract, purchase or permit items, so most of the 526 contract actions have only otherBody (Miami-Dade County / Coral Gables) client matches, which are not Hialeah ties. Firms are given only where the minutes state one (Holland & Knight, Jerry B. Proctor P.A., Vanessa M. Bertran P.A.) or the City of Doral list gives it (marked firmSource). Representatives named for items not in actions.json (e.g. 8 Ball Cafeteria 2025-03-11 11H, Florida Waste Haulers 2025-06-24 11C, Lowe's and Guala second readings, Prestige 29th St 2026-03-24 8G) were not attached. Ambiguous: 2026-03-10 items 11A (Ceasar Mestre) and 11D (Javier Vazquez) name a registered lobbyist without a party and match no kept action; 2026-02-24 11E (Caroline Friedman Frank for an unnamed owner) not attached. Manny Reus is an architect; the minutes list him as "Registered Lobbyist" on some items and only as architect on others, so he is attached only where the minutes say lobbyist or "on behalf of". Family members, property managers and holders of a power of attorney for individual owners were included only where the minutes say "on behalf of" (Julio Perez, Marbely Hernandez Moye, Jose Enrique Cueto); review before publishing as lobbyist ties.
